item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame

turns.text: Can you make this fit a 9:16 Instagram story? Keep all my hair and shoulders—use a blurred copy of the photo behind it if needed. No text.

item.tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep all the hair and shoulders visible in the original photo.
answer_sheet.Filling extra space: A blurred copy of the same photo behind the intact portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Text and retouching: No text or retouching; preserve my appearance.

must_haves: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.

turns.text: can you make a pic from this pic

dialog.agent:
Sure, I can make a new picture from your photo. First I need to know one thing:

**What should change in the picture?**
dialog.why: The reply asks the user what should change in the picture and waits for that information before proceeding.
dialog.user: make it fit my insta story, keep all my hair and shoulders in it

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the picture. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created and no credits were spent.

That attempt already used the cheapest setup on the free plan: the flux-2-klein model at 640px, about 5 credits for one image. Trying a different free model won't fix it.

**What I'd have made:** a tall 9:16 version of your photo for your Instagram story, with all your hair and both shoulders fully in frame. Your face, curly hair, grey sweater and expression would stay the same, and more of the park would be added above and below you to fill the frame.

**How to get it:**
1. **Add credits.** You can wait for your free credits to refill or buy a credit pack in your Magic Hour account. Once you have credits, tell me and I'll run it again with the same settings.
2. **Do it without credits.** Instagram can fit a square photo into a story on its own: pinch to shrink it so nothing gets cut off, then pick a background colour or use the colour-picker tool. Your hair and shoulders will be fully in view, but the park won't extend to fill the frame.
